brief.headline: Index Industries Raises $50 Million in Funding to Reinvent How the World Invests in Real Estate
bullets: Fundraising: Index Industries is co-founded by Josh Rosenthal, formerly the President of Polychain Capital, joining as CEO, and Brian Hardecker, CEO of Longmark and formerly of Blackstone, joining as Chairman.
Family Offices & Wealth: Carlyle has teamed up with SEI to launch a closed-ended private markets interval fund for wealth management clients.
Private Markets: The SEI Carlyle Private Markets Fund will invest across private equity, secondaries, private credit, real estate and collateralized loan obligations.

AI & Technology: The real-life inspiration for Ari Gold on HBO’s hit series Entourage built his career as an agent to some of Hollywood's biggest names, but he was also early to investing in the experiences people show up in person for.

Earnings & AUM: Global investment firm KKR has reported record third-quarter adjusted net income of $1.6bn, up 29% year-on-year, driven by increased asset disposals and management fees, according to a report by Reuters.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,549.94 (up 2.3% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 19.9, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.86% (up 2 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.32 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.34%, near long-run norms (down 8 bps on the prior reading).
